examined_formations.title: Post-trade-fair buyer with shortlisted Chinese suppliers -> follow-up / samples / verification / first-order activation
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A replenishing post-fair state exists, but current China-side sourcing services already package the transition from contact list to samples, supplier verification, factory visit, QC and managed first order.
examined_formations.structural_friction: Remote buyer loses momentum and decision quality when supplier identity, sample, quote and first-order steps fragment after the physical event.
examined_formations.complementary_nodes: China-side supplier-verification, sample, inspection and order-management capacity.

examined_formations.title: Overseas buyer comparing multiple Chinese suppliers -> one traceable sample receiving / comparison / consolidation state
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The sample identity/consolidation problem is real, but multiple current operators explicitly sell receiving, supplier/SKU identification, photos, comparison records, issue lists and consolidated forwarding.
examined_formations.structural_friction: Samples arrive through fragmented parcels with identity/version/freight ambiguity before a supplier is chosen.
examined_formations.complementary_nodes: China receiving desks, sample-recording workflows and consolidated forwarding.

examined_formations.title: Failed China inspection / known defect -> sorting / containment / rework / reinspection before release
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A failed inspection creates a high-energy decision state, but professional QC incumbents already sell the exact containment, sorting, repair/rework, recall and follow-up functions, including public unit pricing.
examined_formations.structural_friction: Buyer must prevent defective units from progressing while converting a defect list into physical containment/correction.
examined_formations.complementary_nodes: Qualified QC inspectors, sorting labor, repair/rework facilities and reinspection.

examined_formations.title: Overseas buyer discovers defects / warranty problem after shipment -> China-side claim evidence, supplier remedy and recovery
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Post-shipment quality and warranty pressure is real, but current after-sales agents and China legal services already package spare-parts, warranty claims, defect resolution, evidence preservation, negotiation and formal recovery; harder cases also become legal/expert rather than generic routable work.
examined_formations.structural_friction: Distance, supplier identity, evidence chain, notice clocks and remedy enforcement make the buyer's post-payment position hard to recover remotely.
examined_formations.complementary_nodes: China-side after-sales coordinators, inspectors, evidence-preservation specialists and PRC lawyers.

examined_formations.title: Overseas buyer plans China factory / supplier trip -> route, appointments, interpreter, transport and visit evidence
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Business-trip and factory-visit coordination has obvious geography friction, but current operators already sell the complete visit stack: supplier appointments, routing, transportation, interpreters, evidence permissions, meeting structure and follow-up.
examined_formations.structural_friction: Factories and meetings span cities, languages and access constraints; a poorly coordinated itinerary destroys scarce buyer time.
examined_formations.complementary_nodes: China-side visit coordinators, interpreters, transport and supplier/factory contacts.
